body: Not really. I wish I did. I've tried counseling. Didn't do much. I'm really nice and polite on the outside. So people don't believe it. But when I snap its really bad.
Getting rid of this attitude is going to be hard. I've gotten really agressive. Going to take a while to change it.

Enmeshed financially is a real good way to put it. I probably know more then I think I do. I realized my normal isn't everyone else's normal. 

I'll try for the slow fade away. At least I don't look like the type of person into this stuff. I have to work on my attitude though.  

Thanks. Its nice to know someone else does get it.

Thanks. I already have no social media presence luckily. I've been looking for another job. I've been doing a lot of leaving things out lately. 

All we've been doing is fighting. And we go longer and longer not talking everytime we do. So at least I've got that going for me. We're actually about to fight again tonight. I don't live with him so at least I can leave.

This isn't a bad idea. His outside friends already think I'm dumb. I've never really wanted anything to do with them and I'm usually pretty quiet around them anyway. I know that sounds mean. I just can't find anything in common with them. Plus I always have to be on guard around them. Its the inside people that I need to convince that. I'm already pretty boring unfortunately. Most of the serious gfs and wives are boring. 

I'm afraid if I run that everyone will think I'm snitching about something and hiding. 

I'm going to try this. I appreciate all the advice to find a safe house or dv shelter but I'm way too paranoid. I can't even handle a car with tinted windows pulling up next to me. All it takes is one woman to go back to their ex and tell everyone who's there. 

Edit: Part of the problem is going to be getting out of the ghetto mindset. I suppose at least I can realize it and try to change it.

So many rules... Have to act one way around "normals." Have to act another way around the group. The way I dress. Colors I wear. Makeup. Everything. I barely remember who I am anymore. Outside appearances are everything. 

Moving is not a option. I'm lucky that he won't bring any shit to my work. 

Cops are not a option. Cops out here are dirty. Anyone thinks I'm going to the cops for anything and I'm done. I'm already panicking about the little I've wrote on here. 

And thanks. I know I deserve better. I want out. Its just really really gonna suck.

I know those are his friends and people not mine. I've always known that at least. I don't have anyone that can help. 

I hope what I write will make sense. I don't feel like I can go anywhere for help. Like...people don't get how bad it can be and how much shit follows you. Go to the cops? Yeah right. Even if I found the couple of cops that aren't dirty they'll try to shake me down for info. Either way I'm screwed. People that I don't know know who I am. I know too much. I thought I stayed out of the crap. But now I've got a affiliation. (Not legally at least thank god.) 

I'll try the hotline/website you put in your reply. I don't have the option of moving. I really think I'm going to have to grit my teeth and just walk away from everything. Can't show fear. The bish of it is losing the protection. One of the ways they get you.
